programme.title: Un trésor dans votre maison

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: Laura est amoureuse de Jason, un jeune garçon qui rêve de devenir un grand scientifique. La jeune fille est bouleversée lorsqu'une machine parlante diffuse sa déclaration d'amour….

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: C'est l'effervescence chez les Ingalls ! Mary a été sélectionnée pour participer à un concours de mathématiques. Elle se rend à Minneapolis avec sa mère...

Hen et Athena sont invitées avec d'autres personnalités de la vie civile à participer à un voyage de trois heures dans l'espace. Mais une tempête géomagnétique va endommager les satellites et l'un d'eux vient percuter la capsule des astronautes en orbite terrestre basse….
Athena et Hen affrontent de nouveaux dangers dans l'espace tandis que, sur Terre, l'unité 118 porte secours aux victimes des chutes de débris dues à la tempête magnétique.

Alors que la station spatiale internationale est gravement endommagée par des débris, Athena et Hen doivent risquer leur vie pour réparer un bras robotique et permettre le retour de l'équipage sur Terre. En parallèle, des flashbacks révèlent un ancien drame qui a marqué Athena et façonné son sens du devoir et du sacrifice.

À Halloween, l'unité 118 doit gérer des événements étranges comme un accident causé par un conducteur sans tête, un homme persuadé d'être mort et un ballon citrouille géant. Parallèlement, Buck s'installe dans sa nouvelle maison et reçoit des signes du fantôme de Bobby, tandis qu'Eddie questionne sa foi après plusieurs phénomènes troublants.

Maddie encourage Chimney à accepter le poste de capitaine de la 118, malgré ses doutes. Lors d'une réunion familiale, plusieurs personnes sont grièvement blessées après un accident de tir à la corde. Athena enquête sur le cyberharcèlement ayant poussé Alicia à une overdose. Buck aide Harry à intégrer l'académie des pompiers malgré ses antécédents judiciaires.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

Hen poursuit des soins dans un centre de bien-être pour des symptômes inexpliqués qu'elle cache à ses proches. Après plusieurs interventions, dont un accouchement d'urgence en forêt et un grave incendie, son état se dégrade et elle s'effondre en mission. Pendant ce temps, un nouvel assistant IA, censé faciliter le travail au centre d'appels, complique davantage les choses et oblige l'équipe à intervenir. Les proches d'Hen organisent une confrontation pour l'aider.

programme.title: De l'autre côté du périph
programme.desc: Dans une cité de Bobigny est retrouvé le corps de la femme de Jean-Éric Chaligny, premier patron de France au centre d'un conflit social qui secoue la France. Deux mondes radicalement opposés vont alors se croiser : celui d'Ousmane Diakité, policier de la section financière de Bobigny, et celui de François Monge, capitaine de la police criminelle de Paris. Leur enquête va les emmener d'un côté à P

programme.title: The Rookie - le flic de Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nolan et Bradford espèrent désamorcer une guerre de la drogue avant que des vies innocentes ne soient fauchées. Harper souhaite que Chen travaille comme agent infiltré.

programme.title: The Rookie - le flic de Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nolan se blesse en poursuivant un voleur à l'étalage que l'assistant du procureur veut inculper pour agression malgré l'opposition de Nolan. Par ailleurs, Lucy mène sa mission d’infiltration, la salle de réception du mariage de Lopez est saisie par le FBI et Nolan rencontre sa nouvelle voisine.

programme.title: The Rookie - le flic de Los Angeles
programme.desc: C’est la première journée pour deux nouvelles recrues et Lucy n’apprécie pas le traitement de faveur que leur réserve Tim. Nolan se porte volontaire pour la protection de Fiona Ryan, sa professeure d’éthique victime de harcèlement….

programme.title: The Rookie - le flic de Los Angeles
programme.desc: Après avoir conduit son fils Henry à l'hôpital suite à un malaise, Nolan retrouve son ex-femme, Sarah. Lopez découvre que « La Fiera » se trouve dans le même hôpital et mène l'enquête pour comprendre ce qui amène la baronne de la drogue à Los Angeles.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead. However, the very much alive Inspector travels to Hong Kong to investigate a dangerous drug lord (Robert Webber). Dyan Cannon and Herbert Lom also star.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Heaven Can Wait
programme.desc: Heaven Can Wait is a romantic fantasy about Joe Pendleton, a Los Angeles Rams quarterback who is accidentally summoned to Heaven by an overly zealous celestial escort.

programme.title: Rockers
programme.desc: Night Flight Presents: Starring Leroy 'Horsemouth' Wallace and Richard 'Dirty Harry' Hall; ROCKERS is a story of oppressed Jamaican musicians getting even with the 'mafia types' in the business

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

programme.title: Grease

programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day, 1976, The Band gave its farewell concert at Winterland in San Francisco. On hand to help say goodbye to this influential rock group were some of the most acclaimed Musicians of the late 1960s and '70s.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When serial killer Charles Lee Ray is mortally wounded in a police shoot-out, he uses a voodoo spell to transfer his soul into Chucky, a Good Guys doll. Young Andy receives the doll as a birthday gift, and Chucky soon resumes his killing spree.

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Dita Jonë
programme.desc: ”Dita jonë” sjell në ekran informacionet e para dhe larmi temash të aktualitetit. Programi vjen te teleshikuesit me rubrika, analiza dhe intervista nga të ftuar të rëndësishëm.

programme.title: A2 Sot
programme.desc: Programi intensiv me informacione të çdo ngjarje të ditës nga vendi, rajoni dhe bota, prej orës 10:00-17:00. Raportime, lidhje direkte dhe shumë rubrika të tjera.

programme.title: Puls
programme.desc: PULS, emisioni më i ri në A2 CNN, vjen çdo ditë me gazetaren Bruna Çifligu, duke sjellë temat më të nxehta të aktualitetit dhe duke shkuar në zemër të ngjarjeve. Debate, analiza, histori njerëzore, gjithçka që prek shoqërinë dhe politikën në kohë reale.

programme.title: Ditari Pasdites
programme.desc: Ditari, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme, kryesisht politike, në 3 edicione qendrore. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: Rretheqark
programme.desc: ”Rretheqark” është dritarja që hapet çdo mbrëmje mbi botën në lëvizje. Në një orë, zbulojmë labirintet e gjeopolitikës, aty ku pushtetet maten, aleancat ndryshojnë dhe diplomacia shkruan historinë në heshtje. Ju çojmë në prapaskenën e ngjarjeve që përcaktojnë ekuilibrat globale e rajonale. Një udhëtim rretheqark , për të parë jo vetëm çfarë ndodh, por edhe ku po shkon bota dhe rajoni.\r\n”Rretheqark”, cdo mbrëmje në orën, 22:00. Nga Rosalba Bejdo dhe Xhevahir Qardaku.”.

programme.title: Edicioni qendror
programme.desc: Edicioni qendror informativ, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme te dites. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: OFF the Record
programme.desc: ”Off the Record!” me Andrea Danglli ka si qëllim të sjellë në ekran misionin e gazetarisë së thelluar dhe analitike. Emisioni synon shtjellimin e një teme të caktuar që shqetëson shoqërinë nga e shkuara apo aktualiteti duke zbuluar përgjigjet e pikëpyetjeve të ngritura nga qytetarët përmes zërit të tyre, debatit apo informacionit për publikun.

programme.title: Sous le soleil
programme.desc: Laure revient d'Afrique pour faire soigner Zacharie, un orphelin de 10 ans. Elle a un accident de voiture avec Jessica, qui fait une fausse couche. Jessica et Baptiste optent pour l'adoption et finissent par accueillir Zacharie. Laure annule un voyage en Afrique pour soutenir Jessica, en pleine dépression. Le yacht de Yannis Nomikos, le père de David, arrive à Saint-Tropez. Yannis apprend qu'il es

programme.title: La fête à la maison
programme.desc: Père veuf de trois petites filles, Danny Tanner fait de son mieux pour les élever et subvenir à leurs besoins. Il peut aussi compter sur le soutien de son beau-frère Jesse et son ami Joey, qui se sont installés chez eux pour aider Danny. Les choses sont sur le point de bouger à nouveau lorsque celui-ci devient présentateur de l'émission debout San Francisco et qu'il y rencontre Rebecca.

L'arrivée inopinée de sa mère, qui souffre de troubles bipolaires, ne favorise pas l'équilibre de la jeune femme. Kerry, de son côté, est profondément troublée par Kim Legaspi, une belle psychiatre qui ne fait pas mystère de son homosexual

programme.title: Avrupa’da Türk Takımları
programme.desc: UEFA Liga e Evropës (anglisht: UEFA Europa League) është një kompedicion i përvitshëm futbollistik i organizuar nga UEFA që nga viti 1971 ku konkurojnë klubet evropiane. Klubet kualifikohen në këtë kompedicion bazuar në performancat e tyre në ligat dhe kupat kombëtare përkatëse. Është kompedicioni i dytë për nga rëndësia nga UEFA, duke u renditur mbrapa UEFA Ligës së Kampioneve.

programme.title: Şampiyonlar Ligi Özel
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.title: AVRUPA LİGİ ÖZEL
programme.desc: Liga e Evropës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion vjetor i futbollit për klube, i organizuar që nga viti 1971 nga UEFA për klubet evropiane të kualifikueshme. Është kompeticioni i nivelit të dytë i futbollit evropian për klube, duke u renditur poshtë Ligës së Kampionëve të UEFA-s dhe mbi Ligën e Konferencës të UEFA-s. I prezantuar në vitin 1971 si Kupa UEFA, ai zëvendësoi Kupën e Panaireve Ndërqytetëse. Kompeticioni mori emrin e tij aktual në vitin 2009, pas një ndryshimi të formatit që përfshinte një bashkim me Kupën Intertoto të UEFA-s, duke zgjeruar fazën e grupeve dhe duke ndryshuar kualifikimin. Në sezonin 2024–25, faza e grupeve u zëvendësua nga një fazë lige me 36 ekipe. Fituesit e Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s kualifikohen për Superkupën e UEFA-s dhe Ligën e Kampionëve të UEFA-s të sezonit pasardhës.

programme.desc: A dramatic plane crash finds Hobie and his mother trapped in the rapidly flooding fuselage beneath the sea while Mitch and the Baywatch lifeguards mount a massive rescue effort to save the trapped passengers and crew.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Romance is in the air at Baywatch as Mitch and Jackie's friendship grows more intense, Summer and Matt begin a relationship, and Hobie falls in love with Lauren, a junior lifeguard with a devastating secret.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: John D. Cort, Mitch's friend and a former lifeguard, returns to Baywatch where his life undergoes a devastating change. Meanwhile, Hobie meets a very "unique" new friend.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Summer has love problems when Slade returns from a world surfing tour to discover Matt and Summer are dating. CJ is persistently pursued by a bungee jumping balloonist. Meanwhile, Garner patrols the beach on horseback.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A prison break gone awry finds Mitch held hostage by a beautiful woman and forced to perform surgery on her escaped convict husband. Meanwhile, Matt and Slade decide to settle their mutual affection for Summer in a daring surfing contest.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch removes a bullet from an escaped convict, only to realize that he and his wife have every intention of killing him. Stephanie's sister Caroline arrives with her fiancé, who becomes the target of an attempted murder.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch saves two boys from drowning. But when one ends up in a coma, Mitch suffers from PTSD and is left reevaluating his life as a lifeguard.

programme.title: Baywatch

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA is back with a bantamweight world title fight as Darrion Caldwell looks to defend his belt against dangerous opponent Leandro Higo. Card also features the return of baddest man on the planet, Joe Warren, as he takes on veteran Joe Taimanglo.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Budapest with a lightweight showdown between Benson Henderson and Roger Huerta. Also on the card, heavy-handed wrestling phenom Ed Ruth and Bellator Kickboxing Champ Denise Kielholtz return to MMA.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA is in St. Louis, MO with a barnburner main event as former lightweight champ Michael Chandler takes on Brandon Girtz. Also on the card, undefeated phenom, AJ McKee puts his record on the line when he meets Justin Lawrence.

programme.title: Bellator 198: Fedor vs Mir
programme.desc: Bellator MMA heads to Chicago, IL with a historic matchup in the Heavyweight Grand Prix as two former world champs collide when Fedor Emelianenko takes on Frank Mir. Plus Neiman Gracie returns to action, while submission ace Dillon Danis makes his debut.

programme.title: Bellator 199: Bader vs King Mo
programme.desc: Bellator MMA returns to San Jose with an absolutely stacked fight card as Ryan Bader collides with King Mo in Heavyweight Grand Prix action; Paul Daley takes on Jon Fitch in a dynamic matchup at welterweight, and Cheick Kongo and Javy Ayala go toe to toe.

programme.title: Bellator 200: Carvalho vs Mousasi

programme.title: Bellator 201: Macfarlane vs Lara

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA returns to Thackerville, OK as Julia Budd puts her women’s featherweight world championship on the line against the undefeated Talita Nogueira in the main event.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Sioux Falls as South Dakota native Logan Storley looks to extend his undefeated streak as he takes on the always dangerous AJ Matthews. Bantamweight king Darrion Caldwell moves up to featherweight to face Noad.

programme.title: Bellator 205: McKee vs Macapa
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Boise, Idaho with an explosive featherweight main event as rising star AJ McKee takes on dangerous veteran John Macapa. Also looking to stay undefeated is Rafael Lovato Jr. as he faces fellow submission specialist John Salter.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to San Jose. Legends Rampage Jackson and Wanderlei Silva settle the score with a rematch ten years in the making. Finally, in the main event Gegard Mousasi defends his Middleweight belt against Rory MacDonald.

programme.title: Bellator 207: Mitrione vs Bader
programme.desc: Bellator MMA returns to Mohegan Sun as Matt Mitrione faces off against Ryan Bader in the Heavyweight World Grand Prix semifinals. Roy “Big County” Nelson takes on dangerous Russian Sergei Kharitonov, and top welterweight contender Lorenz Larkin returns.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Les Docs proposent une récompense à quiconque capturera Lamput. Très vite, une vieille dame se présente avec Lamput sous le bras. Comble de l'audace, elle exige de toucher la récompense. Les Docs sont loin d'avoir la somme en question. Désespérés, ils se.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Mama's Family
programme.desc: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show.".

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A man is killed after winning a fortune and then dumping his girlfriend. So, Grissom, Nick, and newcomer to the CSI team, Sara Sidle, investigate this one.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom, Nick, and Sara search for a kidnapped woman and find more than they expected. Catherine and Warrick investigate the hit-and-run death of a little girl.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and Catherine investigate when a leg is found severed from a body in a lake. Meanwhile, Sara and Nick investigate a fraternity pledging gone terribly wrong.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and Warrick take the case of a young man who is found naked in the desert without an obvious cause of death.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Catherine violates department protocol when she takes the case of a rape accusation against her ex-husband. Warrick and Sara search for the missing bullet that will either exonerate or indict a cop for murder.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When a teenager and her sister are the sole survivors of the gruesome murder of four members of one family in a quiet suburban neighborhood, Grissom and his entire team investigate the crime.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Royce Harmon was murdered 3 months ago in a scene staged to look like a suicide. Now another murder has taken place. Whoever the killer is he has a thorough knowledge of forensics, he purposefully has left evidence, and has baffled Grissom and his team.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate the death of a first class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and Sara investigate a bug riddled body found in the desert. Warrick and Catherine look into the theft of some valuable art.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A woman is abducted from a supermarket. In the store, Grissom finds a bathroom stall door that claims five women have been killed.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A man about to go on trial for arson and the murder of his wife and child seeks assistance from Grissom to help prove his innocence.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A bomb goes off in an office building, killing one and injuring many more. The chief suspect is a security guard who left minutes before the explosion and has knowledge in bomb making.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When a single human bone is discovered in the desert, Grissom and Catherine must cover miles of territory to find the rest of the skeleton.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: At a swanky fundraiser, attended by the sheriff, a woman turns up dead in the pool.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A woman is abducted from a mall parking garage. She's raped, beaten, shot and left for dead. Sara collects evidence from her and grows attached to her.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A body is found in a pottery store in what's apparently a robbery that was interrupted.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A couple leaving a restaurant on their anniversary are killed in the street and their car is stolen. The crime scene is compromised when it rains shortly after the CSIs arrive.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: A body found in a restaurant dumpster leads Catherine and Brass into the world of competitive eating. Meanwhile, Nick and Sara investigate the double murder of a husband and wife literally torn apart by man’s best friend.

programme.title: CSI: New York - Dead Inside
programme.desc: A man is found dead in a basement, but the house where the death occurred is found miles away on a barge in the East River. Meanwhile, Flack discovers that his sister lost her job and has a drinking problem.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Warrick se pone al mando por primera vez cuando el equipo investiga el asesinato del estafador, que ha huido con el dinero de unos turistas sólo para ser tiroteado y asesinado en el aparcamiento.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI es llamado cuando un famoso empresario inmobiliario aparece muerto en el ascensor de un hotel.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: La némesis de Grissom, el asesino en serie Paul Millander, reaparece y se cobra una tercera víctima en este apasionante episodio.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un secuestrador ordena a Catherine que acompañe a un hombre que debe entregarle un rescate de un millón de dólares o, de lo contrario, matará a la amante del hombre.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom investiga el asesinato de un fotógrafo de Las Vegas cuyos restos fueron arrojados a una granja de cadáveres cercana.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom, Catherine y Sara tienen que investigar la muerte de un jugador de hockey durante un entrenamiento. Warrick y Nick investigan la aparente muerte relacionada con las drogas de un saxofonista en un casino.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom investiga los asesinatos de cuatro monjes que fueron tiroteados a quemarropa mientras cantaban en un templo budista.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un autobús que transportaba 23 pasajeros de Los Ángeles a Las Vegas se estrella a menos de 40 millas de su destino, matando a nueve personas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Jane Galloway está a punto de sufrir un ataque de nervios. Se ha protegido completamente del mundo exterior, pero eso no impide que un acosador en su ático la mate.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Catherine investigan la muerte a puñaladas de una anciana de 80 años que vivía en una casa destartalada llena de gatos.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Sara investigan cuando el cadáver de un hombre, que ha sido rociado con lejía, aparece enterrado en un parque.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y su equipo se ocupan de su caso más importante hasta la fecha cuando el antiguo jefe de detectives de la ciudad es asesinado al estilo ejecución en su casa tras una fiesta salvaje.

programme.desc: Los CSI investigan cuando se descubre el cadáver de una joven no identificada metido en un carrito de la compra volcado cerca de un paso subterráneo de la autopista.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), un agente secreto, es incriminado por la muerte de su compañero de espionaje e intenta deshacerse de los asesinos del gobierno que lo persiguen. Corre contra el reloj mientras intenta descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Misión imposible 2
programme.desc: El espía más grande del mundo, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), regresa junto con la hermosa Nyah Hall para detener al agente renegado Sean Ambrose, antes de que este libere un nuevo tipo de terror en un mundo desprevenido.

programme.title: Misión: Imposible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt se enfrenta cara a cara con un traficante de armas peligroso y sádico al tratar de mantener su identidad en secreto para proteger a su novia.

programme.title: Misión imposible 4: Protocolo fantasma
programme.desc: El FMI se cierra cuando participa en el bombardeo del Kremlin, lo que provoca que Ethan Hunt y su nuevo equipo se conviertan en rebeldes para limpiar el nombre de su organización.

programme.title: Misión imposible 5: Nación secreta
programme.desc: Ethan y su equipo se embarcan en su misión más imposible hasta ahora, erradicando el Sindicato, una organización internacional ilegal tan altamente capacitada como ellos, comprometida con la destrucción del FMI.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: código sombra
programme.desc: El suspenso no se detiene mientras el recluta de la CIA Ryan queda atrapado en una peligrosa red de intriga y espionaje. Ryan debe pasar de soldado a analista a agente operativo para detener un complot terrorista devastador contra EE. UU.

programme.title: Proyecto Géminis
programme.desc: Will Smith protagoniza esta trepidante película de acción del director ganador de un Óscar Ang Lee. Un asesino a sueldo retirado (Smith) se ve obligado a huir y acaba siendo perseguido por su mayor adversario: un clon más joven de sí mismo.

programme.title: 13 horas: los soldados secretos de Bengasi
programme.desc: Del director Michael Bay, 13 horas es la historia de un grupo élite de seis exmilitares asignados para proteger a la CIA, que lucharon cuando los terroristas atacaron un complejo diplomático estadounidense el 11 de septiembre de 2012.

programme.title: Renegados
programme.desc: En la Cuba de 1898, cinco Buffalo Soldiers encuentran un alijo de oro, desertan y regresan a Estados Unidos, donde ayudan a defender un pueblo afroamericano del KKK, mientras intentan evitar ser capturados por las autoridades civiles y militares.

programme.title: Llanto en el bosque
programme.desc: Es la historia del secuestro de una joven por un desquiciado solitario que llevó a la cacería humana más grande en la historia del estado de Pennsylvania.

programme.title: Silencio
programme.desc: Silencio de Martin Scorsese cuenta la historia de dos misioneros que viajan a Japón en búsqueda de su mentor desaparecido en un momento en que el cristianismo estaba prohibido. Cuando son capturados, ambos hombres se sumergen en una peligrosa odisea.

programme.title: Alto impacto
programme.desc: Ganadora de 3 Premios Óscar, incluida Mejor Película, un accidente une a varios desconocidos en Los Ángeles.

programme.title: Sopa de tortilla
programme.desc: Un master chef mexicanoamericano y padre de tres hijas ha perdido su gusto por la comida, pero no por la vida.

programme.title: El show de Truman: historia de una vida
programme.desc: Truman no sabe que su pueblo es un estudio gigante dirigido por un productor, director y creador visionario (Ed Harris), que la gente que trabaja y vive allí son actores de Hollywood, y que su alegre esposa también fue contratada.

programme.title: Extraordinary Measures (Cbs Films)
programme.desc: La determinación empuja a un padre idealista a unir fuerzas con un investigador médico solitario para encontrar una cura antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Soldier Love Story
programme.desc: Un soldado regresa a su hogar, conoce al niño que le estuvo escribiendo y surge el amor entre él y la madre.

programme.title: Vision Of Love
programme.desc: Una exitosa abogada emprende una búsqueda por su alma gemela le han dicho que su destino está ligado a un hombre llamado Michael.

programme.title: After The Fall
programme.desc: Una jinete joven y prometedora, después de sufrir un accidente, descubre el amor durante su recuperación.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: Megan, una rebelde adolescente de Chicago y su padre policía Bob, se mudan a la casa rural de su infancia.

programme.title: Especies
programme.desc: Un experimento genético genera a una hermosa mujer mutante que amenaza a la raza humana.

programme.title: The Ninth Gate (LAS)
programme.desc: Roman Polanski dirige y Johnny Depp protagoniza este thriller sobrenatural sobre un vendedor de libros raros que descubre un manuscrito demoníaco.

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte V: un nuevo comienzo
programme.desc: Esta vez parece haber puesto la mira en los pacientes jóvenes de una casa aislada. Y más de unos pocos de sus objetivos adolescentes terminan por la mitad, en cuartos ... lo que sea, Jason lo hace.

programme.title: Viernes 13 parte VI: Jason vive
programme.desc: De niño, Tommy Jarvis hizo algo que muchos murieron intentando hacer: mató a Jason Vorhees, el asesino que aterrorizó a Crystal Lake. Ahora, años después, Tommy está atormentado por el temor de que Jason siga vivo.

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte VIII: Jason invade Manhattan
programme.desc: La Gran Manzana está en grandes problemas, ya que el indestructible psicópata Jason Voorhees sale a la ciudad de Nueva York y pinta la ciudad de "rojo".

programme.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer
programme.desc: En este clásico de Tarantino, los bandidos hermanos Gecko cometen una ola de crímenes. Secuestran a un padre y sus dos hijos, y se esconden en un bar mexicano. Pero se enfrentarán a los clientes del bar y se unirán a sus rehenes para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Guerra mundial Z
programme.desc: Guerra Mundial Z es una acelerada epopeya de lo que podrían ser los últimos días de la raza humana. El ex colaborador de la ONU Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) es llamado para ayudar a acabar con la caótica pandemia que se extiende por el mundo.

programme.title: Viernes 13 parte VI: Jason vive
programme.desc: De niño, Tommy Jarvis hizo algo que muchos murieron intentando hacer: mató a Jason Vorhees, el asesino que aterrorizó a Crystal Lake. Ahora, años después, Tommy está atormentado por el temor de que Jason siga vivo.

programme.title: х/ф Круиз по джунглям: Тайна Вальверде
A History of Violence

programme.title: Der Camping Clan – Alles für den Platz
programme.desc: Im brandenburgischen Caputh erstreckt sich das „Himmelreich“, ein familienbetriebener Campingplatz. Die Doku-Soap verfolgt den Wandel und zeigt, ob ihre Strategie aufgeht.

programme.title: Trucking Hell
programme.desc: In dieser Show wird gezeigt, wie verschiedene Männer und Frauen dafür sorgen, dass die Straßen frei bleiben und das Lkw-Business am Laufen halten. Zu jeglicher Wetterlage und Tages- und Nachtzeit begeben sie sich mit ihrem Lkw-Bergungsunternehmen auf die Straßen und kümmern sich um verunglückte Lkws. Dabei geraten die Berger und Bergerinnen nicht selten selber in brenzlige Situationen...

programme.title: Louisiana Law – Die Wildlife-Ranger
programme.desc: Die Serie folgt den Beamten des Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries (LDWF), die darauf spezialisiert sind, die Tierwelt und die natürlichen Ressourcen des Bundestaates zu schützen. "Louisiana

programme.title: 馬克羅伯驚奇製造所:2
programme.desc: 馬克羅伯驚奇製造所:亮粉臭屁彈.馬克的包裹曾經遭竊，因為報警也無法得到解決，他便決定祭出反擊，整整那些順手牽羊的人。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪:15
programme.desc: 金礦的賭注:救星佛萊迪:只要金塊.一心一意只想要採到傳說中的36盎司大金塊，史提夫因此在溜洗過程中流失了大量的粉金，每日只能勉強餬口，甚至必須在改造的貨櫃中過冬。佛萊迪和璜為了幫助史提夫達到買地蓋房子的夢想，必須想出更實際的溜洗方式。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:15
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第15集.本集介紹發電船和動力飛行傘的製作方法。地球上許多偏遠地區無法自己供電，或是遇到天災造成大規模停電時，海上電廠也就是發電船便能派上用場。通常以舊船改造，改造一艘船約需一年時間。一種新興的飛行運動是動力飛行傘，也就是在滑翔翼下加入引擎和螺旋槳葉片，繫帶還能變成座椅，讓玩家可以坐著遨翔天際。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:16
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第16集.本集節目介紹蠟筆、金屬鏡和無鏈條腳踏車的製作。蠟筆是將石蠟熔融，加入色素和水調色，再灌入模具製成。金屬鏡的材料是銅錫構成的青銅合金，先將黏土製成模具，再將合金塊置於模具上方的小杯，封閉後經過熔融自然流入模具，凝固後取出拋光，再與特製鏡框結合便完成。無鏈條腳踏車是用驅動軸取代鏈條，組裝車體時，將鑲齒與軸裝在車輪中間，再連接踏板與車輪，並裝上擋泥板、撥叉和把手便完成。

programme.title: 工程大突破第5季:8
programme.desc: 工程大突破第5季:土耳其德里納水壩.土耳其這個國家有7千萬居民，其經濟發展的速度在全世界已名列前茅。隨著經濟快速成長，對能源的需求也與日俱增。因此它正在國內東部地區興建最重要的基礎設施。即德里納水壩。德里納水壩高800呎，是世上最大的水壩之一。它將擋住楚魯河5千億加侖的水，每年可發出2萬億瓦小時電力，足以供應土耳其3/4家庭用電。而且得其地利之便，造型特殊的拱壩建造厚度只有胡佛水壩的1/3，卻擁有相同的強度。但以它的體積和高度當然不可能一次灌漿，而是採用數千個分離的混凝土塊體互相接合而成。水壩最重要的是水密性。任何可能造成漏水的裂縫都必須填實。而在這麼高的水壩上進行修補工作的確需要勇氣。尤其是建造洩水口閘門軌道時，起重機吊著載有工人的鋼籠懸空數百呎，還必須爬到籠子外施工。就算膽大包天，無役不與的主持人丹尼也要面露憂色了。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:10
programme.desc: 舊貨獵人第19季:被遺忘的寶物.本週的舊貨收購之旅,德魯和阿利斯特兩人前往多塞特擁有大量舊貨古董商家的小城社本，在滿是舊貨商家的街道閒逛，拜訪擁有四十家攤位的古董交易中心。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:8
programme.desc: 理查哈蒙玩很大:鑽油平台.這次理察哈蒙要前往墨西哥灣的超大油氣平台，認識由重型機具構成的巨大廠房和集合住宅，如何遺世獨立運作，又能穩定漂浮在水面。這座巨型海上工廠面臨許多獨特的挑戰，搬運所有物資和零件都得靠吊車進行，每週運來的食材補給也不例外。為求日以繼夜輸出天然氣與石油，所有機具故障都得當場解決，員工待在平台上的時間還比回家多。此外，設備所耗費的大量電力也需要以噴射引擎和蒸氣自產。想要達到日產能的目標，這些條件缺一不可。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪:16
programme.desc: 金礦的賭注:救星佛萊迪:傳奇出手.佛萊迪和璜各自回鄉，除了介紹兩人的家庭，也介紹他們的過往，包括如何踏入採金這一行與如何認識的點點滴滴。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第4季:2
programme.desc: 河中巨怪第4季:俄羅斯消失的漁夫.這集的河中巨怪中，傑洛米將帶大家前往位於俄羅斯東部偏僻地區的黑龍江，準備調查一起三名漁夫溺斃的事件，這三名漁夫相約前往黑龍江出海口捕魚，結果卻不幸溺斃，一年後才尋獲其中兩人的屍體，但第三具屍體始終未能尋獲。傑洛米抵達俄羅斯後，雖然感到大家都很友善，但始終無法問出關鍵線索，所幸後來前往一魚類加工廠時，工廠經理總算透漏，有條大魚就藏身碼頭附近，他利用工廠排出的魚屍塊釣起一條鯰魚，但在見過密沙後，密沙的敘述聽來又不像是鯰魚，反而更像是鱘龍魚，再經確認他才確定黑龍江中真正的河怪，其實是體型更大的達氏鰉，但因達氏鰉體內可取得非常珍貴的魚子製成魚子醬，因此從蘇聯瓦解後，盜獵的問題就如燎原野火般一發不可收拾，而且還有黑道介入，此時傑洛米才明白三名漁夫的真正死因，並為達氏鰉的未來感到憂心，最後他終於在一組科學家的協助下，捕獲一條達氏鰉，並且真心的祈願，達氏鰉不會永遠從黑龍

programme.title: 引擎大師:8
programme.desc: 引擎大師:第8集.鑄鐵歧管、中長度頭段、長管頭段三方大比拼，哪一個最符合你的需求？

programme.title: 人體內的怪物第8季:12
programme.desc: 人體內的怪物第8季:尿液中的異物.護士賈姬去墨西哥義診時，開始出現腹部不適的情況。反回美國後就醫，原本被診斷為間質性膀胱炎。但是任何治療都沒有緩解她的不適，於是她又去尋求其他醫生的診療，在做了化驗之後才確定，她感染了血吸蟲。貝瑞從秘魯背包旅行結束，回到美國加州的家裡倒頭就睡，隔天早上起床發現腿很癢，看起來好像被蚊蟲叮咬。他原本不以為意，後來他的手腕也開始出現叮咬痕跡，而且變得很像紅腫潰爛的傷口。在被轉診給專門研究熱帶地區疾病的感染科醫生後，才被診斷出是皮膚利什曼病。貝瑞在秘魯被受利什曼原蟲感染的沙蚋叮咬，導致原蟲寄生在他體內，後來擴散到手腕。

programme.title: 遠古未解之謎:2
programme.desc: 遠古未解之謎:殺戮戰場.古代世界耐人尋味，無論是史前時期或是文字出現後的時代皆有許多未解的謎題。本集節目討論了幾個神秘案例，包括歐洲最古老的戰場，希臘一處古老墓地裡大群被銬在一起的骨骸，聖經故事摩西分海背後的真相，以及蘇格蘭出土的神祕木乃伊。想知道這些案例背後的真相，敬請鎖定本節目。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:9
programme.desc: 理查哈蒙玩很大:最大工程.理察哈蒙回顧自己造訪過的超大工程，分析這些巨無霸如何型塑當今世界，在經營上又會遇到哪些挑戰。人工智慧在許多巨型工程中已經無法或缺，鹿特丹貨櫃碼頭幾乎已完全自動化，德國福斯車場則持續探究人機如何共事以增進效率。東西越大，需要應付的自然能量也越可觀，從阿爾卑斯山下的鐵路隧道、到維修超大運輸機油箱的機棚，人類都不斷發明創新方法，來克服地球上的種種難題。總歸起來，巨無霸在營運維繫上總少不了人類悉心呵護。

programme.desc: 漁人的搏鬥第22季:混種蟹的詛咒.數十年來，船隊首次深入遙遠北方，追捕一種罕見、近乎神話般的混種帝王蟹，體型更大、肉更多，價值更是不菲。為了捕捉這些珍貴帝王蟹，船長們被迫駛入未知海域，穿越破碎浮冰，迎戰節目迄今拍攝過最猛烈的風暴。

programme.title: 舊礦區新財路第1季:6
programme.desc: 舊礦區新財路:機具升級.艾力克斯與凱文再次來到亞利桑那州普雷斯科特附近，要協助麥克,傑夫與葛雷格興建選礦廠。這三個人有三個金礦場，需要選礦廠來提出黃金，但受限於資金用罄，選礦廠缺臨門一腳才能完成，故向艾力克斯與凱文求助。兩人受到它他們的認真態度以及可能的賺錢潛力吸引，幫忙建立放置顎壓機的基腳台、連接各碎石機之間的輸送帶、替離心機搭蓋防陽光棚等等，讓選礦廠順利運轉。

programme.title: 科幻先知:3
programme.desc: 科幻先知:H.G.威爾斯.科幻小說之父赫伯特喬治威爾斯在著作中，預想到了未來科學跟科技發展的恐怖細節．他最後一直受到一個問題所困擾：人類會自我毀滅嗎? 威爾斯的小說，將維多利亞時代的科學，帶入太空紀元．他的故事背後不只探討科學在未來能做到什麼，還有人類會怎麼運用科學．威爾斯來自維多利亞時代正在工業革命的英國．在他當時的世界，第一部電影攝影機才剛剛被發明；最新的交通科技突破，則是配有鏈傳動跟氣動輪胎的腳踏車．但他撰寫中的小說情節，遠比這些都先進，包括未來中世界毀滅的影像，以及世界間的戰爭．威爾斯在1895跟1898年間寫下了四本經典巨作，探討了各種不可思議的可能性．從火星人,到時光旅行,到隱形，並預測到了世界大戰，甚至核能武器的發展．在威爾斯大多數的小說中，預測人類的毀滅通常不是來自外星人的力量，而是從我們本身的黑暗性格．想知道威爾斯這些預言如何在現在一一成真，請鎖定本集"科幻先知"．

programme.desc: Tommy Ryman grew up with a new-age, folk singing mother and a traditional, Lutheran insurance-agent father. This XY equation evidently equals: acclaimed comedian. Ryman has earned the title of Semifinalist on NBC's Last Comic Standing. Roseanne Barr, a professed fan, raves she has “never seen anything like Tommy before in her whole life, he is one-of-a-kind, fantastic!” Ryman also recently won the title of Best of the Midwest at the prestigious Gilda's Laugh Fest. Ryman's act can be described as absurdist and clever, masked behind a very likable and innocent demeanor, often thought of as awkwardly charming. He is a favorite among audiences at top clubs, corporates, and colleges around the nation.

programme.desc: Over the past decade, Andy Beningo has established himself as one of the hardest working comedians in the business. Performing his clever, "every man" material has led to some 2,700 career performances. Along the way, he has appeared on AXS Gotham Comedy Live, as a final four finalist on CMT's Next Big Comic, and on the Bob and Tom radio show. Beningo's new CD regularly plays on Laugh USA on XM Sirius Radio. He's been hailed for his clean comedy, and was named one of the 40 Best Up and Coming Comedians in the country. He was also named "Best Comedian" by both the Detroit Metro Times and Detroit Hour magazine.

programme.title: David Dyer

He's worked with some of the best comics in the industry including Mike Birbiglia, Jim Breuer, and Lewis Black. He's been a contributing writer to NBC's Late Night with Jimmy Fallon and ABC's Politically Incorrect. He's a regular on the nationally syndicated Bob and Tom Show and often appears on the roster for their “Friends of The Bob and Tom Show” comedy tour. He's the host of a new web series called Sidecar Sessions where he interviews guests who are sitting in the sidecar of his motorcycle as David pilots the bike around town. David also created and stars in another web series called Pillars with co-star, Kevin Yon. David became an on-call firefighter with Grand Rapids Township in Michigan….his wife is nervous.

programme.title: Vagabundo y millonario

programme.title: Live: Noticiero Estrella TV

programme.desc: Nachdem der Xi'an Grand Prix in diesem Jahr ausfallen musste, sprang Shenzhen in die Bresche. Das Finale dort bestritten der amtierende Weltmeister Wu Yize und sein Landsmann Yuan Sijun. Letztgenannter stand erstmals im Finale eines Ranglistenturniers. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc: Der Schweizer Marco Odermatt strebte bei der Veranstaltung in seinem Heimatland den vierten Sieg in Folge an. programme.title: Segeln: SailGP
programme.desc: In Dubai. \n\nNach neunwöchiger Pause fallen auf den letzten beiden Stationen die Entscheidungen der sechsten Saison. When Kringle surprises customers and employees alike by claiming that he really is Santa Claus, it leads to a court case to determine his mental health and, more importantly, his authenticity.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: Le 10 mars 1906, une gigantesque explosion ravage les mines de Courrières, dans le Pas-de-Calais. A plus de 300 mètres sous terre, César Danglot et douze de ses camarades entament une incroyable lutte pour survivre. Pendant vingt jours et vingt nuits, ils errent dans les ténèbres, tandis qu'à la surface, la catastrophe bouleverse la France et provoque une révolte ouvrière.

programme.title: Mundësia e fundit
programme.desc: Ish-ushtari i forcave speciale Jake Harris rikthehet në aksion kur ish-shoku i tij i armëve, tashmë terrorist, merr peng krerët e ushtrisë amerikane në një bunker bërthamor. Me kohën që po mbaron, Harris duhet të përballet me një ushtri mercenarësh për të ndaluar vjedhjen e kodeve bërthamore dhe një katastrofë globale.

programme.title: Fati i Ushtarit
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks. Gjatë Betejës së Ardenëve, në Luftën e Dytë Botërore, një kapiten amerikan mbetet i vetmi i mbijetuar i njësisë së tij, i bllokuar pas vijave armike. I plagosur dhe i izoluar, ai duhet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe aftësitë e tij për të shmangur trupat gjermane dhe për t’u kthyer në linjat aleate.

programme.title: Patrulla e Putrave: Aventura me Dinosaurët
programme.desc: Pas një stuhie misterioze, anija e Patrullës së Putrave përplaset në një ishull tropikal të panjohur, të banuar nga dinosaurët. Atje, këlyshët takojnë Rex-in, një qenush që ka mbetur i bllokuar prej vitesh dhe është bërë ekspert i botës parahistorike. Por kur planet e kryetarit Humdinger shkaktojnë shpërthimin e një vullkani, ekipi duhet të bashkojë forcat për të shpëtuar ishullin.

programme.title: Nata e Djallit 6: Nga Bota e Përtejme
programme.desc: Gemma, një nënë e re që jeton me vajzën në shtëpinë ku është rritur, zbulon se mund të udhëtojë në botën e shpirtrave dhe të sjellë qeniet e mbinatyrshme në botën e të gjallëve. Kur forcat e errëta zbulojnë aftësinë e saj, ajo përballet me një kërcënim që rrezikon gjithçka. Kapitulli i ri i sagës horror ”Nata e Djallit”.

Cette perte d'une immense partie du trésor national français reste à ce jour le plus grand casse de l'histoire.

programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute

programme.title: S0E12 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Pasi Jiti e lë në shtëpi, gjendja e Zelihasë përkeqësohet. Vdekja e Namëkut trondit Sadullahun dhe Nihatin. Jiti përgatit planin për të grabitur Sadullahun. Kybra dhe Jiti takohen përsëri, por këtë herë në shtëpinë e tij. Ç’plan ka Jiti për florinjtë e vjedhur?

programme.title: S0E46 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Ferhati dhe Asllëja gatuajnë së bashku, por asnjëri nuk e prek temën e divorcit. Abidini i propozon Gylsymit për martesë. Si do të reagojë ajo? Me lejen e Ferhatit, Asllëja dhe Abidini shkojnë të marrin Gylsymin dhe Jeterin. A do të pranojnë ato të kthehen në shtëpi?

programme.title: S0E166 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Pojrazi, Zylfikari dhe Kokëmadhi bien në kurthin e Ihsanit. Çfarë do të bëjë Meltemi për t’i shpëtuar ata? Pse thirret Sema në prokurori dhe çfarë kërkon të dijë kryeprokurori nga ajo? Kush është gruaja misterioze që ka shpikur formulën e drogës së re në qarkullim?

programme.title: S0E72 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Prishja e fejesës nxjerr në dritë tradhtinë e Nexhlës, e cila largohet me Oguzin pas një përballjeje të ashpër me Lejlën. E shkatërruar nga ajo që ka ndodhur, Lejla përfundon në spital. Shevketi niset në kërkim të çiftit, ndërsa Fikreti mendon të heqë dorë nga martesa për t’i qëndruar pranë familjes.

programme.title: S0E8 - Loja e Fatit
programme.desc: Ada përpiqet t’i afrojë Borën dhe Tuçen përmes mesazheve të një gruaje misterioze, me shpresën se kështu do ta rikthejë Ryzgarin. Ndërsa Bora kërkon personin që nxori videon e tij, Tuçe i ngarkon Adës edhe punën e shkrimit. Familjarët shtojnë presionin për martesë, kurse Tuçe vendos të ndahet nga Ryzgari.

programme.title: S0E167 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Aishegyli dhe Pojrazi vazhdojnë të ndjekin planet e tyre në bashkëpunim me kryeprokurorin. Songyli kërkon medoemos që ta ndajë Sadretinin nga Begumi. Çfarë ka kurdisur ajo këtë herë? Ndërkohë Nesheti i shpreh ndjenjat e tij Aishegylit . Si do ta presë kjo e fundit?

programme.title: S0E73 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Ali Rizai mëson sa shumë të vërteta i janë fshehur dhe e drejton zemërimin edhe ndaj Fikretit. E lënduar, ajo vendos t’i qëndrojë planit për t’u martuar me Tahsinin. Ndërkohë, Oguzi dhe Nexhla përgatiten të largohen drejt Gjermanisë, por Shevketi zbulon udhëtimin e tyre.

programme.title: S0E9 - Loja e Fatit
programme.desc: Ndarja e Tuçes nga Ryzgari e gëzon Adën, por ai këmbëngul se është i dashuruar me Tuçen. Bora pranon të takojë gruan me të cilën ka shkëmbyer mesazhe, ndërsa Ada përpiqet ta çojë planin e saj deri në fund. Kur takimi dështon, mbrëmja i afron papritur Adën dhe Borën.

programme.title: S0E13 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Jiti vë në zbatim planin e tij. Do të rezultojë i suksesshëm? Kybra nuk ndihet mirë. Ç’po ndodh me të? Sadullahu niset të vrasë Jitin. Si do ta ndalojë Kybra këtë? Emiri fillon të dyshojë për dosjet që shefi i tij i dha për shqyrtim. Njerku i Derjas nuk di të ndalet, si do të shkojë puna e saj?

programme.title: S0E47 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Jeteri kthehet në shtëpi. Si do ta presin familjarët e tjerë? Gylsymi pranon propozimin e Abidinit. Ky i fundit takohet me Ferhatin dhe i tregon për propozimin që i ka bërë Gylsymit. A do ta pranojë Ferhati këtë gjë?

programme.title: Kad lišće pada
programme.desc: Pas dorëheqjes së Ali Rizait dhe pranimit të Nexhlës në universitet, familja Tekin zhvendoset në Stamboll për një jetë të re. Mes vështirësive të përshtatjes dhe sfidave të qytetit të madh, Ali Rizai përpiqet ta mbajë familjen të bashkuar dhe të ruajë vlerat e ndershmërisë që e kanë udhëhequr gjithë jetën.

programme.title: Pitanje časti
programme.desc: Pasi djalit të vogël të shtëpisë, Emirit, i fillon stazhi në Stamboll, Zelihaja fillon planet për tu larguar. Por si do të reagojë vjehrri i saj kur ta marrë vesh këtë? Ajo e bind Hasanin të largohen, duke lënë çdo gjë pas dhe nisen drejt Stambollit. I afërmi i Zelihasë do t’i ndihmojë të ngrenë biznesin e tyre. Çfarë i premton Jiti të ëmës në ditën e tyre të parë në shtëpinë e re?

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: After battling off Garmadon’s Stone Army, the Ninjas finally arrive at the Temple of Light where they harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd who becomes more powerful than he ever imagined.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: When the Ninjas’ attempt to return Garmadon’s ‘Helmet of Darkness’ to its perch at the Celestial Clock in order to prevent the final battle between Lloyd and his father from beginning fails, a Super Weapon is created that can destroy all of Ninjago.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: When Garmadon uses his new Super-Weapon to turn Jamakai Village evil, he unwittingly unsettles the balance, allowing the spirit of the Overlord to cross over and possesses his body.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon’s Super-Weapon has turned it evil but Lloyd and the Ninjas discover that light is more powerful than dark - and the final and ultimate battle is on.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.sub-title: The Art of the Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.sub-title: The Curse of the Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu

programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade and all contestants team up against the Ninja.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Chen has failed to bring the return of the Serpentine War but Clouse reveals there’s another way – his daughter has the ability to absorb the power of every fighter she comes across, so she can complete the ceremony.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: The Ninja reunite with Wu and turn to the aid of a shrunken Pythor in order to figure out how to defeat the unstoppable Anacondrai.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: The Ninja and fighters discover there’s a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Chen’s Anacondrai army... but even with the new Destiny Bounty, their forces still aren’t strong enough.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission…

programme.desc: Une plongée dans le crime de Gianni D. écope de 25 ans de prison pour le meurtre d'Aïssatou en 2016, et deux cambrioleurs sont condamnés pour le meurtre de l'élu Alain Ghozland.

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: 盡忠職守的警員王偉業, 因捐血意外救活了韓江, 遭同袍責難其「救魔」所為。原來韓江是「鬼王黨」首領, 為人邪惡毒辣, 多次殺警。在一次圍捕鬼王黨行動中, 偉業目睹同袍被韓江活活燒死, 勾起了他潛藏內心十多年, 一件不為人知的罪孽往事, 令他精神幾近崩潰。偉業為了贖罪, 開始用邪惡的手段伸張正義, 忠直的警察, 眼神卻是邪惡而暴戾, 仿似是被韓江操控的邪惡影子。

programme.title: 龍鳳店
programme.desc: 明朝正德皇帝朱厚照年少貪玩。為了逃婚, 帶同指揮使、御醫、吏官三人, 私下江南。皇帝因搶食乞兒雞, 誤撞腦部而失憶。後遇龍鳳店之李鳳姐收留, 並協助打理業務, 有聲有色。寧王欲借此機會, 殺害皇帝, 圖謀作反, 派人胡亂找個理由, 強將皇帝拉去刑場, 即時處斬。在危急關頭, 指揮使、御醫、吏官三人發現皇帝, 出手相救, 和寧王伏兵大打出手。最後, 寧王被捕, 鳳姐卻說皇帝欺騙感情, 不接受皇帝封賞, 皇帝如何挽救此美好良緣, 戲中自有交代。

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: 1950年冬天, 冰天雪地的長津湖區域, 一場美國與中國煉獄般的血戰即將拉開序幕。中美雙方分別派遣最為精銳的王牌部隊出戰 - 中國人民志願軍第9兵團、美軍陸戰第1師, 步兵第7師。兩支部隊在戰役中多次展開驚心動魄的殊死較量, 中方在面臨極端嚴寒、食不果腹、以及巨大武器差距等諸多艱險條件時, 依舊毫無懼色、頑強抗戰、視死如歸, 最終成功炸毀水門橋, 並取得了抗美援朝戰爭中最為關鍵的一場決定性勝利。

programme.title: 重生
programme.desc: 在隱蔽的城市角落, 利慾薰心的販毒集團不擇手段, 致使無數人因沾染毒品而家庭破碎、墜落深淵。被毒販迫害至家破人亡的張耀為復仇, 與緝毒隊長安渡暗中合作, 二人聯手做局狠辣除害, 誓要將犯罪集團的榜一榜二大哥穆坤和安佩全部剷除。然而沒想到在這背後竟藏著一場精心佈置的復仇棋局, 是同仇敵愾還是各懷鬼胎?在這場較量中, 到底誰才是執棋人, 誰又是被操作的棋子?當危機悄然而至, 是沉淪還是警醒, 一切請小心為上...

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 誠實選舉媽 2
programme.desc: 朱尚淑在首爾市長選戰中落選後, 變成了一個無業游民, 但某天她偶然拯救了一名落海的民眾而上了新聞, 進而獲得在故鄉華麗回歸的機會。然而, 朱尚淑卻因太過誠實, 導致支持率跌到谷底, 就在她又要重新開始說謊的瞬間, 竟又變得只能說真話, 而且這次竟連她的祕書室長也無法說謊?!

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 材貌出眾的黑鳳在一貴族學校讀書, 她最大的志願是能夠嫁給皇子, 成為皇妃, 而二皇子在學校遇到黑鳳後亦一見鍾情, 二人互生情愫。一天, 學校突然出現一名殺手--盲俠「一地雞毛」, 企圖行刺校長......

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第7集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第2集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: 問心 2 第24集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第8集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: 盡忠職守的警員王偉業, 因捐血意外救活了韓江, 遭同袍責難其「救魔」所為。原來韓江是「鬼王黨」首領, 為人邪惡毒辣, 多次殺警。在一次圍捕鬼王黨行動中, 偉業目睹同袍被韓江活活燒死, 勾起了他潛藏內心十多年, 一件不為人知的罪孽往事, 令他精神幾近崩潰。偉業為了贖罪, 開始用邪惡的手段伸張正義, 忠直的警察, 眼神卻是邪惡而暴戾, 仿似是被韓江操控的邪惡影子。

programme.title: 龍鳳店
programme.desc: 明朝正德皇帝朱厚照年少貪玩。為了逃婚, 帶同指揮使、御醫、吏官三人, 私下江南。皇帝因搶食乞兒雞, 誤撞腦部而失憶。後遇龍鳳店之李鳳姐收留, 並協助打理業務, 有聲有色。寧王欲借此機會, 殺害皇帝, 圖謀作反, 派人胡亂找個理由, 強將皇帝拉去刑場, 即時處斬。在危急關頭, 指揮使、御醫、吏官三人發現皇帝, 出手相救, 和寧王伏兵大打出手。最後, 寧王被捕, 鳳姐卻說皇帝欺騙感情, 不接受皇帝封賞, 皇帝如何挽救此美好良緣, 戲中自有交代。

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: 1950年冬天, 冰天雪地的長津湖區域, 一場美國與中國煉獄般的血戰即將拉開序幕。中美雙方分別派遣最為精銳的王牌部隊出戰 - 中國人民志願軍第9兵團、美軍陸戰第1師, 步兵第7師。兩支部隊在戰役中多次展開驚心動魄的殊死較量, 中方在面臨極端嚴寒、食不果腹、以及巨大武器差距等諸多艱險條件時, 依舊毫無懼色、頑強抗戰、視死如歸, 最終成功炸毀水門橋, 並取得了抗美援朝戰爭中最為關鍵的一場決定性勝利。

programme.title: 重生
programme.desc: 在隱蔽的城市角落, 利慾薰心的販毒集團不擇手段, 致使無數人因沾染毒品而家庭破碎、墜落深淵。被毒販迫害至家破人亡的張耀為復仇, 與緝毒隊長安渡暗中合作, 二人聯手做局狠辣除害, 誓要將犯罪集團的榜一榜二大哥穆坤和安佩全部剷除。然而沒想到在這背後竟藏著一場精心佈置的復仇棋局, 是同仇敵愾還是各懷鬼胎?在這場較量中, 到底誰才是執棋人, 誰又是被操作的棋子?當危機悄然而至, 是沉淪還是警醒, 一切請小心為上...

programme.title: 誠實選舉媽 2
programme.desc: 朱尚淑在首爾市長選戰中落選後, 變成了一個無業游民, 但某天她偶然拯救了一名落海的民眾而上了新聞, 進而獲得在故鄉華麗回歸的機會。然而, 朱尚淑卻因太過誠實, 導致支持率跌到谷底, 就在她又要重新開始說謊的瞬間, 竟又變得只能說真話, 而且這次竟連她的祕書室長也無法說謊?!

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第7集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第2集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: 問心 2 第24集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第8集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.desc: Mientras están al cuidado de la hermana mayor de Susie, Tommy y su amiga sospechan que hay monstruos dentro de la casa. El Abuelo les cuenta a Angélica y a Tommy de lo mucho que se peleaban Hugo y Julio cuando eran niños.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Cuando la película “Reptar 2010" se rompe, cada Rugrat cuenta su propio final de la historia, describiendo un Reptar que se parece a ellos mismo. Cuando uno de los inventos de Hugo no sale como debía, decide conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: El que da y quita / Fiebre de oro
programme.desc: Después de que Carlitos admira uno de los juguetes de Tommy, Tommy decide dárselo, pero luego se arrepiente. Los Rugrats encuentran una moneda en el parque y Angélica hace que los niños traten de encontrar más.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Películas caseras / El misterioso Sr. Mambo
programme.desc: Mientras Hugo muestra unos videos caseros de sus vacaciones, los Rugrats deciden narrar sus propias historias sobre sus vidas. Hugo inventa un muñeco que habla para los niños, pero ellos lo encuentran aterrador.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Cuando Angélica y Carlitos se quedan atados con unas esposas de juguete, tienen que encontrar la forma de separarse. Mientras nieva en el barrio de los Rugrats, los bebés se marchan hacia el patio para buscar el Polo Norte y a Santa.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Destino: la Luna / El cumpleaños de Angélica
programme.desc: Los bebés se escapan al tráiler del Abuelo, confundiéndolo con una nave espacial. Angélica tiene miedo de cumplir años y tener más responsabilidades, entonces comienza a actuar como un bebé.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: La princesa Angélica / La pareja dispareja
programme.desc: Angélica malinterpreta unos comentarios de sus padres y se piensa que es una verdadera princesa. Cuando Tommy se queda en la casa de Carlitos por algunos días, las mañas de cada uno les empiezan a molestar.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Tommy al desnudo / Tommy y el club secreto
programme.desc: Tommy decide que le gustaría andar desnudo como su perro, Firulais. Angélica forma un club secreto y hace que los bebés compitan para entrar en el club.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Bajo la cama de Carlitos / Carlitos es rico
programme.desc: Cuando Chas reemplaza la cuna de Carlitos por una cama de nene grande, Angélica le dice a Carlitos que debajo de la cama hay un monstruo. Chas gana la lotería, por lo que él y Carlitos se vuelven millonarios.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Mi pequeña empresaria / La maravillosa vida de Carlitos
programme.desc: Carlota lleva a Tommy y Angélica al trabajo. Ellos hacen un desastre y casi arruinan un contrato. Un ángel de la guarda, le muestra a Carlitos como hubiera sido la vida de su familia si él nunca hubiera nacido.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Carlitos tiene un sueño muy real, y los bebes intentan convencerlo de que no está soñando. Cansada de ser dejada de lado en la casa de Phil y Lil, Angelica dice que ella sabe quien de los mellizos es el favorito y cuál el olvidado.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Carlitos es pelirrojo / Firulais se va de la casa
programme.desc: Carlitos está cansado de que la gente bromee con su pelo colorado, y le pide a Tommy que se lo tiña negro con la tintura del Abuelo. Cuando Firulais se pierde, Hugo trata de reemplazarlo con una serie nueva de juguetes.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Angélica convence a los bebés de que Carlitos es un extraterrestre. Después de que Chas le habla a Carlitos sobre los gérmenes, Carlitos tiene temor de tocar cosas por miedo a tener contacto con gérmenes.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: La peor pesadilla de Angélica / Los bebés de los Mega Pañales
programme.desc: Carlota anuncia que está embarazada, y Angélica teme ser olvidada una vez que nazca el bebé. Los Rugrats se imaginan que son héroes para recuperar los muñecos de su programa de televisión favorito que Angélica les quitó.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: Un nuevo chico en el pueblo / Pickles contra Pickles
programme.desc: Cansados del maltrato de Angélica, los Rugrats van a jugar con otro niño en el parque llamado Josh, quien termina siendo peor que Angélica. Angélica decide denunciar a sus padres cuando ellos tratan de hacerle comer brócoli.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Los Rugrats van a la casa de Boris y Minka para pasar las Pascuas y, por accidente, se quedan todos encerrados en el ático. Para pasar el tiempo, Boris les cuenta a los bebés la historia de Moisés.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.sub-title: El niño y la televisión / Se está cayendo el cielo
programme.desc: Cuando Hugo rompe el televisor, los Rugrats usan una caja vacía para crear sus propios programas. Angélica les dice a los bebés que el cielo se está cayendo y que está llegando el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Rugrats: aventuras en pañales
programme.desc: Carlitos adopta una mascota, el insecto Melville. Cuando Melville muere, a Carlitos le cuesta mucho aceptarlo y pasa por todos los procesos del duelo. Angélica les pide a los Rugrats que la mantengan alejada de las galletas.

programme.title: The Casagrandes (LAS)
programme.sub-title: Ese loro enamorado de la luna / Una cita con el destino
programme.desc: Sergio busca la ayuda de Adelaide para convertirse en un caballero y recuperar a Priscilla. Después, Rosa escucha una predicción sobre María y Arturo que podría cambiarlo todo.

programme.title: The Casagrandes (LAS)
programme.sub-title: El maleficio del duende de los dulces
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso duende comienza a causar problemas relacionados con los dulces, Ronnie Anne y su familia intentan romper el supuesto maleficio antes de que arruine la celebración.

programme.title: The Casagrandes (LAS)
programme.sub-title: Cogiendo el truco / Nasío para no peleá
programme.desc: Héctor se une a su equipo de fútbol como amuleto de la suerte, pero su fortuna falla. Luego, Sergio pide ayuda a Adelaide para recuperar a Priscilla y Rosa escucha una predicción sobre María y Arturo que podría cambiarlo todo.

programme.title: The Casagrandes (LAS)

programme.desc: Ronnie Anne y sus amigos se unen para formar una banda y enfrentan problemas al intentar tocar juntos. Después, la familia compite por romper un récord en el barrio mientras todo se vuelve cada vez más caótico.

programme.title: The Casagrandes (LAS)

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper’s Fire Trick!
programme.desc: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: It’s Not Okay! The Spider lures Sanji!
programme.desc: Sanji hears a woman's scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it's a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
programme.desc: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Yamato’s Past! The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea!
programme.desc: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido's head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Marco’s Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
programme.desc: The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro's way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro's determination and tries to pave the way for him.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
programme.desc: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
programme.desc: Luffy's strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he's ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls "heaven."

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
programme.desc: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
programme.desc: Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Otama’s Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
programme.desc: After watching the Straw Hats' departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she's here on Onigashima, it's time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sanji’s Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
programme.desc: Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
programme.desc: Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn't just them who were devastated by Queen's raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
programme.desc: The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors’ Deadly Attack!
programme.desc: The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
programme.desc: The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law’s Sword Technique!
programme.desc: Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
programme.desc: Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
programme.desc: Countless souls have been lured along the Grand Line in pursuit of the legendary One Piece! Luffy D. Monkey is a young pirate with a dream: to prove the legend true and be king of them all!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enter the Great Swordsman! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro!
programme.desc: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
programme.desc: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
programme.desc: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
programme.desc: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
programme.desc: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy’s pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
programme.desc: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami arrive at an island hoping to obtain a ship and crew, but the three are quickly confronted with the blustering Captain Usopp – who has a connection to Luffy’s past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
programme.desc: Luffy follows Usopp to the mansion and encounters the brutal pirate Captain Kuro. The scoundrel plans to claim Kaya’s fortune and live the stolen life of luxury.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
programme.desc: Usopp spreads the word of Kuro’s evil plot and the impending pirate attack, but no one believes his warnings. The Straw Hat Pirates decide to help Usopp put a stop to the dastardly scheme.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
programme.desc: Luffy and crew seek to best Captain Kuro, but they’ve prepared their defense on the wrong side of the island! All looks grim now that Usopp must face off against the Black Cat Pirates alone.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
programme.desc: In an effort to save Usopp’s village, the Straw Hat Pirates seek to block the marauders’ path from the sea. With Luffy out of the battle, Zoro must face the fearsome Meowban Brothers!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
programme.desc: Nami manages to rescue Zoro’s missing swords and attempts to revive Luffy. With one of the Meowban brothers down, the other rages on even more fiercely than before!

programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Cinque Terre und Amalfi, Pompeji und der Vesuv, Venezia und der Schiefe Turm von Pisa - wer kommt nicht ins Schwärmen, wenn es um "Bella Italia" geht. Die weltgrößte Modellbahnanlage, das Miniaturwunderland in Hamburg, präsentiert auf 190qm seinen Besuchern diesen Urlaubstraum. Vier Jahre lang haben über 50 Modellbauer daran gearbeitet, die charakteristischsten Sehenswürdigkeiten nachzubauen.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Fürstenhof, hôtel cinq étoile au cœur de Vagen en Bavière, est l'épicentre des histoires qui lient de nombreux habitants de la région. Qu'il s'agisse de ses propriétaires, son petit personnel ou d'autres personnalités influentes, les intrigues mêlant amour, argent, famille et trahison qui gravitent autour de l'établissement sont nombreuses.

programme.desc: 1985: Ein Informant enthüllte den Glykolweinskandal, bei dem österreichische Winzer Wein mit Diethylenglykol streckten. Der Skandal eskalierte zu einem politischen Wirtschaftskrimi, angereichert durch Berichte über Vergiftungen. Als auch deutsche Weine betroffen waren, folgte eine amtliche Warnung. "Glykol" wurde zum Symbol für einen der größten Lebensmittelskandale in Österreich und Deutschland.

programme.desc: In einem ehemaligen Laden zu wohnen, war lange der große Traum von Astrid. In Diez hat sie ihn sich verwirklicht und mit akribischer Planung ein ehemaliges Ladengeschäft zu einem Zuhause im Industriedesign für sich und ihre Familie umgebaut. Im 300 Jahre alten Haus war einst ein Juwelier untergebracht, später dann ein Elektronikgeschäft, eine Kfz-Werkstatt und zuletzt ein italienisches Reisebüro.
